peopleTuning.rationale: Neutral initial coefficients; development and understanding remain separate from innate aptitude.

evaluation.rationale: Absolute six-foundation thresholds, matched comparison population and explicit deferral of equal scores.

genetics.rationale: Two quantitative loci per body/root target; explicit allele selections and mutations are frozen at conception. Marker definitions may use dominance rules.

declaredPolicyDefaults.catalogScope: Species/trait catalogs are declarations; absent catalog entries are not counted as used.

scope: Derived reading of existing raw observations only; no world created or advanced.
Partial individual snapshots are at progressMonth; time series/generation/milestones are at sampledThroughMonth.
Entry/foundation/core counts use retained individual formations. Baseline8042 Born is absent; no body age inferred.
Point ranges describe retained120-month samples; not between-sample extrema.
Labor person-months include waits; reservation unit-months are separate and not added.
Host times include different audit/report protocols; no device/Android speed or law timing cause inferred.
Old7ce calibration is not acceptance for newer source fingerprints.
